Preprocess Data for App Generation

Source: R/generateShinyApp.R
preprocess_for_app.Rd

This function runs all necessary preprocessing steps on the input data for the SMEW app.

Usage

preprocess_for_app(
  intensity_csv,
  metadata_csv,
  output_dir,
  denoise = F,
  anno = NULL,
  adducts = NULL,
  ion_mode = NULL,
  organism = "Human",
  ppm = 10,
  only_annotated = FALSE,
  histology_images_dir = NULL,
  run_autocorrelation = FALSE,
  top_autocorrelated_peaks = 10,
  n_cores = 1,
  run_pixel_enrichment = FALSE,
  multi_modal_path = NULL,
  enrichment_controls = NULL,
  enrichment_comparisons = NULL
)

Arguments

intensity_csv

Path to the intensity matrix CSV file

metadata_csv

Path to the metadata CSV file

output_dir

Directory to save processed data

denoise

Logical; whether to denoise the data (default FALSE)

anno

Optional annotation data.frame or NULL

adducts

Optional adducts table or NULL

ion_mode

Ionization mode (character or NULL)

organism

Organism name (default 'Human')

ppm

Numeric; mass accuracy in ppm (default 10)

only_annotated

Logical; if TRUE, only annotated peaks are used (default FALSE)

histology_images_dir

Optional directory with histology images

run_autocorrelation

Logical; whether to run spatial autocorrelation (default FALSE)

top_autocorrelated_peaks

Integer; number of top autocorrelated peaks to use (default 10)

n_cores

Number of cores for parallel processing (default 1)

run_pixel_enrichment

Logical; whether to run pixel-level enrichment (default FALSE)

multi_modal_path

Optional path to multi-modal data file

enrichment_controls

Optional vector of control samples for enrichment

enrichment_comparisons

Optional vector of comparison samples for enrichment

Value

List or path to processed data
